day: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one landscape 16:10 reference still for an original third-person action adventure game, a credible real-time game image rather than detailed illustration. An adult female forest ranger, about seven heads tall and 1.7m, stands naturally on a narrow grassy forest path facing the camera in front three-quarter view. Full body occupies about 40 percent of image height. She wears a practical moss green hood and short layered tunic, muted ivory sleeves, warm dark leather belts and broad bracers, charcoal trousers and brown boots. Real adult facial proportions, sturdy capable anatomy, medium warm skin, short dark hair under the hood. In her right hand, held relaxed beside her leg, a simple broad steel sword with a restrained bronze crossguard. The clothes have broad painted colour gradients, slightly darker at the base, lighter on top. No fine texture maps, no shiny surfaces. Very soft painted/cel shaded 3D rendering with readable simplified geometry. Setting is airy green forest in daylight: elegant spreading deciduous trees, dense fine curved knee-low grass forming a soft continuous olive and fresh green field, a few rare white flower clusters, distant hills fading into blue-green haze. Warm sun, cool lifted shadows, pale blue sky. The atmospheric openness of Breath of the Wild and mature playable character proportions, but entirely original design: no Nintendo characters, pointed elf ears, symbols, architecture or clothing motifs. Camera at 1.6m, wide field of view, not telephoto. No UI, no labels, no text, no watermark. Avoid a child's face, toy look, chibi proportions, photorealism, ornate detail, spiky grass, dark forest or cinematic depth blur. This is a provisional visual target, not a screenshot of a shipped game.
dusk: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one provisional target still, landscape 16:10, of an original third-person adventure game's sword fight at dusk. Use the supplied image only as a reference for the adult female ranger's design and painterly game art. Preserve her adult seven-head proportions, green hood and tunic, ivory sleeves, broad leather bracers, dark trousers, brown boots, simple broad steel sword with bronze guard. Show a clear readable combat action from behind her right shoulder at third-person gameplay distance, the player occupying about a third of frame height, sword contacting the flank of a large moss-covered stone stag with restrained branching antlers and glowing amber heartwood on its back, among weathered standing stones in a forest clearing. A small ordinary cat companion stands to the side. This is visual composition only, no boss redesign showcase. Readable blade, right hand and planted feet, one small warm hit flash, no particle clutter. Low warm evening sun, peach sky fading to lavender, lifted blue violet shadows, soft olive-green grass in broad continuous fields, thin curved blades, few flowers, airy distant forest. Broad painted colour ramps on simplified 3D geometry rather than detailed illustration. No shiny surfaces, no photorealism, no text, no UI, no watermark, no Nintendo characters or symbols, no child/toy/chibi proportions.
rain: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one landscape 16:10 provisional target still of the same original adult female forest ranger in the supplied design reference, running through tall grass in rain, seen from behind and slightly to her right at normal third-person gameplay distance. Full body occupies about 35 percent of the height, adult about seven heads tall. Green hood and short tunic, muted ivory sleeves, broad dark leather belts and bracers, dark trousers and brown boots; her simple broad steel sword is carried low in her right hand. Her boots part a DENSE continuous carpet of delicate curved grass 25 to 45 cm tall. Grass is a SOFT SINGLE FIELD of moss green with broad 10 to 30 metre warmer patches, gently lighter warmer tips, no exposed dirt between blades, no pale spikes, only two tiny flower clusters far away. Rolling wind bends whole waves of grass with a soft travelling sheen. A forest opening and layered blue-green hills recede into rain mist. Overcast blue-grey sky, soft cool daylight, LIFTED readable shadows and clear player silhouette, not dark green mud. Thin visible rain streaks, no shiny wet plastic. Painterly simplified real-time 3D art, broad painted garment gradients, no fine fabric texture. Same adult identity and original clothing as reference, no Nintendo characters or symbols, no UI, text or watermark, no child/chibi/toy proportions, no cinematic blur.
vista: Use case: stylized-concept. One landscape 16:10 provisional wide-vista reference still for the original third-person adventure The Wilds. Use supplied image as visual identity and colour reference. Camera at a forest trail overlook, adult female green-hooded ranger shown small in foreground left, seven-head adult proportions, practical green tunic, ivory sleeves, leather belts and bracers, dark trousers, boots, plain broad sword hanging by her right leg. The main subject is an expansive breathable landscape: soft continuous fields of thin curved green grass waving in broad bands, deciduous forest canopies, a winding path that gives the eye a route into the middle distance, layered mossy cliff outcrops, distant blue-green wooded ridges and a lake partly revealed in the valley, pale cyan sky and broad warm white clouds. Rare tiny flower clusters. Painterly real-time stylized 3D look with simplified forms, soft light ramps, lifted cool shadows, warm sunlight and strong atmospheric perspective. Original terrain and character, no recognizable Nintendo architecture, symbols or characters. No UI, no text, no watermark, no toy scale, no photorealistic texture detail, no dark roots or pale triangle-spike grass. Wide field of view with deep focus and a clear horizon.
